title: Generate, Evaluate, Iterate: Synthetic Data for Human-in-the-Loop Refinement of LLM Judges

bias_targets.methodology: Iterative human-in-the-loop refinement of LLM-as-a-judge criteria using synthetic test cases generated across varying domains and personas to classify text as 'Biased' or 'Non-biased' based on favoritism, lack of neutrality, or one-sided perspectives.
